marketing.style: Spacious, editorial Bento grid with negative space
marketing.hero: Large kinetic text with masked line-by-line reveal. Background #F2F1EE.

product.style: Information-dense, clean white canvas, persistent aspect ratios
product.grid: Responsive masonry or dense CSS grid (gap-4) for candidate cards
product.cards: Subtle 1px border (#C2C2C2), no heavy shadows. Pill overlays for tags.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C7493A] text-white rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-bold hover:bg-[#a63d30] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#488A6D] text-white rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-bold hover:bg-[#3b7259] transition-colors

cards.marketing: bg-white p-8 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-[#C2C2C2]/50
cards.product: bg-white p-4 rounded-lg border border-[#C2C2C2] hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

badges.verified: bg-[#88D8B0]/20 text-[#488A6D] border border-[#88D8B0] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll for marketing page
motion.hero_reveal: Framer motion staggered text reveal (y-axis mask)
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards (-translate-y-1), gentle scaling on images

visual_enhancers.marketing: Subtle noise overlay on the Cream background to make it feel like premium editorial paper. Minimal drop shadows, prefer 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.product: Clear visual hierarchy with tags and badges. Focus on data density without clutter.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions but heavily customize them to match the ElevateMe brand (Charcoal, Terracotta, Green).
Marketing pages MUST be built with custom HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (no restrictive Shadcn containers) but use Shadcn for forms/modals.
Product UI MUST be information-dense and rely on a strict grid with 1px #C2C2C2 borders, skipping heavy shadows.
DO NOT use pure black (#000000). Use Charcoal #1A1A1A.
DO NOT use generic blue SaaS gradients or cyberpunk aesthetics.
Maintain a light theme architecture as requested ('Premium light, editorial').

instructions_to_main_agent.marketing_site: Build a landing page with a kinetic hero ('FIND THE RIGHT TALENT. GET HIRED FASTER.'), an editorial marquee, and numbered manifesto chapters. Use the Cream #F2F1EE background. Add 'Why This Match?' card example.
instructions_to_main_agent.product_ui: Build a Talent Intelligence Dashboard featuring Candidate comparison tables, Shortlists, and Match Intelligence breakdowns with dense, functional UI on a White #FFFFFF background.
